items.resume_2026-08-28_fresh_session: Prior session hit the 1-hour absolute watchdog right after the 'wip...pre-selftest checkpoint' commit and never finished; this is a fresh session picking the pushed branch back up, not a restart. Branch was 2 merges stale (base 3e3dd8f, before PR #264/#265/#266). `git rebase origin/main` succeeded with zero conflicts, but `git push --force-with-lease` was DENIED outright by a blast-radius policy (irreversible-operation guard) -- force push is unavailable in this environment as a hard policy, not a style preference. Recovered non-destructively via `git checkout -B <branch> origin/<branch>` (resets the local ref to match origin, not a history-discarding op) then `git merge origin/main` (merge commit `64633a6`, zero conflicts). Pushed as a normal fast-forward (`684d0e6..64633a6`), no history rewrite. `git diff origin/main..HEAD --stat` re-confirmed after the merge: still exactly the 4 files in `known_scope_notes` below, program/agents/**/config.yaml and all SKILL.md untouched, tests/test_233_review_routing_activation.py untouched (it came in via the merge from main, not modified). Re-ran every gate below fresh against `64633a6`; numbers changed slightly from the branch's own PR-body draft (written before this merge) because D10 (live `gh` state) is a genuinely time-varying condition, exactly as ADR-0025 discloses -- not a regression.
items.admission_gap_root_caused: Investigated WHY qa/reviewer_* continuation slots are unavailable, rather than taking the prior session's conclusion on faith. Traced bin/nightshift-ctl: `claim acquire --claimant crew_alpha/lead ...` -> denied 'implementer claim requires an admitted known task'; task_admissions rows are never INSERTed anywhere in nightshift-ctl itself (grep confirms zero write sites) -- admission is a root-policy/platform-side effect of a legitimate engineer NEW-slot dispatch, which this task never had (its registered `agent` is 'lead', not a COUNTED_AGENTS engineer, and its `state` is 'in_review' not 'pending', so a NEW slot is unobtainable now regardless). Without admission, `_derive_normal_phase` structurally refuses both the qa continuation path (role=qa) and the review continuation path (role=reviewer) before it even reaches the task's pr_url/claim checks. This is a genuine, mechanical dead end for any WA-5-built task, confirmed by reading the source, not re-asserted from precedent.
